methods.params: Exactly one string targetId, matching the official Page.close request.
methods.result: success=true after removing the named page target.
methods.events: Target.detachedFromTarget for every actual attached session, followed by Target.targetDestroyed. After the close boundary, releasing a response that was proven server-held before close emits no Runtime.consoleAPICalled from the closed page; all observed console events retain their phase.
methods.scope: The named page in its browser context; sibling pages and other contexts remain live.
methods.errors: Missing, extra or nonstring targetId values and unknown targets fail.
methods.evidence: Playwright 1.60 Chromium CDP and Obscura CDP two-page probes use the same exact closeTarget shape and closed-page error; the surviving Obscura page retains its closure, settled timer promise, remote handle and document. The fixture confirms the closed page request is pending, releases it only after the recorded close boundary, and retains every phase-tagged console event. Rust tests cover events and strict parameters.

methods.params: Render builds qualify the observed Playwright mouseMoved, left mousePressed and mouseReleased shapes, including force 0.5 on press. Coordinates, button, buttons, modifiers, clickCount and force are validated; omitted button on press/release is a verified no-event success.

methods.events: The fixed fixtures qualify trusted pointermove/mousemove, pointerdown/mousedown, focus/focusin, pointerup/mouseup and click order, constructors, coordinates, button/detail/modifier and pressure fields. The triple-click fixture also qualifies its dblclick event and text selection. Canceled pointerdown, mousedown and checkbox click preserve their measured effects.
methods.scope: Page session and current document. Browser-owned hit testing, captured dispatch and press state survive page overrides; navigation and document.open invalidate the previous input epoch. Wheel, pen, pointer capture, hover boundary events, multi-button gestures and user activation are not qualified by this slice.
methods.errors: Malformed move/press/release parameters return -32602. Missing target sessions, no-render coordinate input, pen and nonzero tangential pressure/tilt/twist return errors; unsupported native capabilities use -32000. The legacy wheel branch still has separate, incomplete validation.
methods.evidence: Playwright 1.60 native_mouse_smoke.py: six offline fixtures compared with Chromium 148.0.7778.96 on macOS arm64, with full protocol and fixture wire captures. Rust mouse/default-action, document epoch and frame-navigation regressions cover the shared Page path.
